messages:
Olivia Park: Heads up - Nimbus Cloud Services submitted INV-2026-2107 for May firewall appliances ($8,450.00) but invoice lists vendor ref N-554 not our PO. No PO printed. Can AP confirm routing?
Ben Torres: @Olivia link please and I'll search PO system.
Olivia Park: link -> https://files.redwood/test/invoices/INV-2026-2107.pdf Vendor email says 'PO N-554'.
AP Bot: Invoice INV-2026-2107 uploaded. Status: pending PO match.
Ben Torres: Searching... nothing exact. Closest is PO-NIM-0554 from 2023 but it's closed/Expired.
Ravi Shah: This looks like hardware for edge security project (cost center 4480). Did we renew a PO for Nimbus recently? @Contracts Bot any active contract?
Contracts Bot: Contract NIM-2024 active. No matching open PO found. Contract has 'hardware procurement' clause; requires PO for payment.
Olivia Park: Vendor emailed saying shipment already delivered. If they won't reissue quickly we need exception to pay. Ravi - do you authorize payment on retro PO?
Ravi Shah: I can authorize if procurement confirms delivery and asset tag is recorded. @Ben please confirm asset onboarding completed.
Ben Torres: AP can't pay without PO or documented exception. I can create retro PO-INT-NIM-2026-055 if procurement signs off.
Olivia Park: I'll confirm with asset team now.
Ben Torres: Created PO-INT-NIM-2026-055 and linked to INV-2026-2107 (status: pending approval).
Contracts Bot: Note: mark retro PO with reason 'vendor invoice present' and attach delivery confirmation.
Olivia Park: Asset team confirmed serials and RMA records. Delivery confirmed. Ravi you good to approve?
Ravi Shah: Approved. :white_check_mark: Funds available in 4480. Approve payment on exception and require vendor to reissue future invoices with full PO number.
AP Bot: Approval recorded: Ravi Shah approved PO-INT-NIM-2026-055. Invoice set to pay on next AP run. Reminder sent to vendor to include PO on future invoices.
Olivia Park: Thanks all. Keeping thread open until vendor reissues invoice with PO.
AP Bot: Thread update: INV-2026-2107 status -> Approved (retro PO).
